name: Zwischen uns das Kreuz
source:
"Zwischen uns das Kreuz" revolves around six characters and their political views in a fictional future of Germany ("Neo Germania"). Their relationships and political views are the game's main topic. The decisions you make directly impact the game's storyline as well as the ending. 

[From [url=https://retromaccaroni.itch.io/zwischen-uns-das-kreuz]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《Zwischen uns das Kreuz》圍繞六名角色及其政治觀點展開，背景設定在虛構的未來德國「新日耳曼尼亞」。人物關係和政治立場是遊戲的核心主題。玩家做出的選擇會直接影響遊戲劇情和結局。

[來源：[url=https://retromaccaroni.itch.io/zwischen-uns-das-kreuz]Itch.io[/url]]
